provenance_note: 732.1-B-3 prints no example frame, only the first OID octets (Annex H). Hand-derived from 732.1-B-3: §4.1.2 (Primary Header: TFVN 4 bits = 1100, SCID 16, Source-or-Destination 1, VCID 6, MAP ID 4, End of Frame Primary Header Flag 1, Frame Length 16 = total - 1, Bypass/Sequence Control 1, Protocol Control Command 1, Reserve Spares 2, OCF Flag 1, VCF Count Length 3, VCF Count 0-7 octets; Table 4-1, flags 01 reserved; Table 4-2), §4.1.3 (Insert Zone), §4.1.4 (TFDF Header: rule 3 bits, UPID 5 bits, pointer 16 bits for rules 000-010 only; Table 4-3; the OID frame of §4.1.4.1.5-12), §4.1.5 (OCF), §4.1.6 and Annex B (FECF, G(X) = X^16 + X^12 + X^5 + 1, preset by L(X)), §4.3.11.2-3 (delimiting and the USLP Frame Validation Checks), §5 Tables 5-1 to 5-4 (managed parameters), §6.3 (Security Header after the Insert Zone, Trailer before the OCF; none in protocol control frames), Annex D (truncated frames: 4-octet header, 1-octet TFDF Header, length 6-32 from the VC, SDLS 6/16 and at least 28 octets), Annex H (OID generator). UPID values from the SANA snapshot specs/sana/uslp_protocol_id.tsv, read by the model at run time. COP-1 control commands from 232.0-B-4 §4.1.3.3 (Unlock = 00, Set V(R) = 82 00 V(R)). Check order, validation reason codes, the delimiter's valid header, the writers' error order, and the configuration kept, as docs/standards/uslp-frame.md §2.1 and §3 state them (OI-35, OI-44). SCID 0x155 is the fictional SCID of the reference scenario (APP-026); SCID 0xF0A5 is also fictional. Expected values computed by an independent Python model of those clauses, test-vectors/models/uslp_frame.py (TV-023), written independently of the Rust codec and sharing no code or method with it (headers as bit strings from the figure widths, the FECF as the Annex B remainder by GF(2) long division and checked by the B1.2.1 syndrome, the OID data from the Galois form of Figure H-2, checked against the Fibonacci form and the printed pattern). Error cases name the field code of 03 §9.1. One rule-000 frame with its FECF, register octet by octet, and one truncated frame are worked by hand in docs/verification/derivations/uslp-frame.md. `python3 -I test-vectors/models/uslp_frame.py --check test-vectors/uslp/*.json` recomputes every expected value.
